## Recipes - Web Search (Multi-Provider)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/recipes-web-search

**Parameters:**
- `query` (required): Search query
- `provider`: openai, openai-mini, claude, claude-haiku, gemini (default), gemini-pro, mistral, mistral-premium
- `options`: { search_depth, max_results, language, allowed_domains[], blocked_domains[] }
- API keys: `openai_api_key`, `anthropic_api_key`, `google_api_key`, `mistral_api_key`

**Notes:**
- `allowed_domains` only works with Claude
- Mistral search is NOT guaranteed (agent decides)
- Gemini uses Google Search, OpenAI uses Bing, Claude/Mistral use Brave
